mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.book_id AS bookId, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN book b ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY oi.order_id DESC, oi.id ASC

SELECT oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.book_id AS bookId, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN book b ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id ASC

SELECT b.id AS bookId, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.name AS categoryName, b.price, b.stock, b.status, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS soldQty FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN book b ON b.id = oi.book_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING_PAY') GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.cover_url, c.name, b.price, b.stock, b.status ORDER BY soldQty DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
